about: Shared examples for card-schema.json: normalize_cards(input) must equal output, in the plugin (tests/test_cards.py) and in Conduit (RichCardSchemaTests). Regenerate only when the schema changes, and copy both files to Conduit together.

cases.name: A map with a route keeps everything valid
A place card keeps only its first place
A rating, hours, price or photo without a source is left out
A sourced rating keeps its count and link
Unknown keys are dropped
Text is cleaned and cut
A card with no valid places is dropped
An unknown type is dropped
Out-of-range coordinates are dropped, the place stays
A bad URL or a rating out of range drops that fact
A route is dropped when a place was dropped
A route is dropped when it names a missing place or runs from a place to itself
A route is dropped from a non-map card; an integer must be whole
A route without a start keeps starting where the user is; mode case is fixed
Booleans aren't numbers and non-objects are dropped
At most twelve cards and ten places
A URL that could end a Markdown link early is dropped
A title keeps its brackets and a cycling route is kept
A stats card keeps its numbers and source, and nothing of a map
A stats card without stats is dropped; a one-value spark and an unknown trend are left out
A chart keeps the series that have one value per label
A pie keeps its first series, and a negative slice drops it
A chart whose series all miss labels is dropped
A forecast keeps what it was given, with its source
A forecast without a source or anything to show is dropped
An empty hours or days list counts as nothing to show
A comparison recommends one option at most
A comparison needs two options
Steps keep what's needed and their timers

steps.text: Lower the eggs in and simmer.
Lower the eggs in and simmer.

cases.name: Needs and a source stay off a map; steps need steps
Media keeps its items, and an image has no length or artwork
Media without a source is dropped
A contact keeps only a phone and an email that read as one
An email that could add a recipient or prefill a message is dropped
A status keeps its state, and a live name stays on the first card that has it
A live name goes on any card type
Media keeps only https items and artwork, and is dropped with none left
A place's or person's photo is kept only when its url is https
A person's message is kept only with their phone

cases.name: A table's numbers, blanks and nulls become text in their places, and a row that doesn't fit is dropped
A table with no row that fits is dropped
A timeline keeps days with stops and stops with text
A checklist keeps one item per text, whatever its case
A list keeps https photos and its ranking
A progress card keeps goals above 0
A callout's tone matches without regard to case

cases.name: A diff keeps its files, hunks and totals, and a renamed file its old path
A hunk keeps lines starting with +, - or a space, with their spaces; a binary file and a bad id keep nothing
A diff line longer than 1001 characters is cut there, never trimmed
A diff with no file left is dropped
